items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: And the Imperial Band, Perez and those fellas, they started playing.

ctx.x: How did your father play and those fellows you played with, what style did they play?

Well, they played at old time. You see, those days they had music that mostly looked like manuscript, but they called it German music, you know. They used to come from the old country, you know. Mm-hmm. And that's what they played. And they had a set of books they called Manhattan books, dance books, you know. Well, they had quadrilles and they had mazookas and they had waltzes and they had lances and baratas and all that type of music they played those days, you see. Well, they didn't play no jazz, you know what…
Who do you think was the first band to ever play any jazz or whatever?
